verdict.rationale: WezTerm's own docs list ligatures and font fallback as headline features, and the config docs cover changing font size. Community users independently cite ligatures as a reason to choose it over Alacritty or Windows Terminal. One user called it 'severely lacking in font configuration', but that is an unspecific opinion rather than a concrete failure, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: documented fine-grained font tuning beyond size (e.g., per-weight/style rules, harfbuzz feature toggles, line-height/cell metrics), and detail on configuring fallback chains.
